description: Reference month, stored as the first day of the month (2026-08-01 is August 2026).

Geography as published. Canada only in the manufacturing and wholesale inventories files. Canada, the ten provinces and the three territories in the wholesale sales file, where Northwest Territories includes Nunavut from January 1993 to December 1998.
Statistics Canada Dissemination Geography Unique Identifier for the geography.

Industry exactly as published, with its North American Industry Classification System code in square brackets where it has one, for example Food manufacturing [311] or Wholesale trade [41]. Durable goods industries and Non-durable goods industries are official aggregates without a code. In the wholesale files, labels such as Wholesale trade (excluding oilseed and grain) [41 - 41112] are official totals that leave out the named industries.

The code inside the square brackets of naics_industry, copied out for easier filtering (for example 311, 31-33 or 41 - 41112). Empty for the durable and non-durable aggregates. Added here, not a separate official column.

manufacturing_by_industry_monthly.csv only. Principal statistic as published: Sales of goods manufactured (shipments); New orders, estimated values of orders received during month; Unfilled orders, estimated values of orders at end of month; Raw materials, fuel, supplies, components, estimated values at end of month; Goods or work in process, estimated values at end of month; Finished goods manufactured, estimated values at end of month; Total inventory, estimated values of total inventory at end of the month; Ratio of total inventory to sales; Ratio of finished goods to sales.
Unadjusted or Seasonally adjusted, as published. The official notes say a few new wholesale industries, such as cannabis, are published unadjusted only.
Unit of measure for value, as published: Dollars, or Ratio for the two manufacturing ratio statistics.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the unit of measure.
Scale of value as published. thousands for all dollar values, so 70000000 means 70 billion dollars. units for the two manufacturing ratios.
Statistics Canada numeric code for the scalar factor.
Statistics Canada vector identifier for the series. Useful if you want to pull the same series again.
Statistics Canada coordinate string that locates the series inside the official table.

The published value: dollars in thousands, or a ratio for the two manufacturing ratio statistics. Empty when Statistics Canada did not publish a figure (status x, F or ..). Official values were not altered.

Statistics Canada status symbol. A, B, C and D are data quality grades (excellent, very good, good, acceptable) on a published value, and E means use with caution. x means suppressed to meet the confidentiality requirements of the Statistics Act, F means too unreliable to be published, and .. means not available for that reference period; for those three the value is empty. Empty status means a regular published value.
Additional Statistics Canada symbol when present. Empty in all three files in this snapshot.
t if Statistics Canada has terminated this series, otherwise empty. Empty in all three files in this snapshot.
Number of decimal places Statistics Canada uses when displaying the value.
